dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Where should we go to find a tea set?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Having a cup of tea isn't exactly the most urgent thing to do right now... but at the same time, this lovely old man from 500 years ago has been through so much, and it makes Paimon so sad...

dialogues.speaker: Ei
dialogues.text: I'm also feeling very nostalgic for his tea.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, why don't we go to the Kamisato Estate? There'll definitely be a tea set we can borrow there.
